messages:
maya: Mini-fridge update — the Tupperware wormhole claimed 2 yogurts and a hummus. If you put food in the tiny top shelf, it disappears. :crying_cat_face:
aj: Wait wtf, that's where I put my lunch. When did this start?
katie-b: Seen it since Monday. I opened it and all the granola bars slid into a black crevice behind the compressor. We need to label things or stick a reminder.
devon: Noted. Breaking out the emergency fridge-sherpa kit at 3pm if anyone wants to join a rescue mission :mag_right:
sam: I can bring gloves and a flashlight. Also bringing a pack of replacement oatmilk for whoever's missing one. :thumbsup:
maya: Also quick ask — can we reboot the mini-fridge? It gets loud and might be causing the sliding. Ops-bot, do we have a work order template?
ops-bot: @channel Automated maintenance ticket template attached. Use: 
```
Title: Mini-fridge — top shelf clearance
Desc: Investigate missing items, defrost if needed, secure loose shelving
Priority: Low
Owner: facilities
```
aj: Filed as #3421 — facilities will check tomorrow morning.
katie-b: Small suggestion — can we put a "snack credit jar" on the counter? People can leave $ for communal snacks instead of stealing each other's yogurts. Vote: 🍪 for yes, 🥨 for no.
devon: 🍪
sam: 🍪
maya: 🥨 (I prefer people label their stuff)
aj: 🍪
katie-b: Cool — I'll start a petty cash jar today and label it "snack credits". I'll also stick a post-it on the top shelf: "DO NOT STACK: TINY TOP SHELF = BLACK HOLE" :sticky_note:
maya: Legend. Thanks everyone — rescue mission at 3 for volunteers. If you can't, please label your lunch. :wave:
